subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Fake Vacation Rental
description: One-minute skill: The Fake Vacation Rental.

hook.text: You book a beachfront villa. You arrive. The property doesn't exist — or belongs to someone else.

buildup.text: Scammers list properties they don't own on booking sites, using stolen photos and descriptions.

discovery.text: They insist on direct payment outside the platform to avoid the site's buyer protections.

twist.text: Victims are stranded at their destination with no accommodation and no refund available.

climax.text: Vacation rental fraud spikes during peak travel seasons when urgency overrides caution.

punchline.text: The view was real. The listing was fiction.

quiz.question: How do vacation rental scammers avoid detection?
options: They use fake identities on the platform
They insist on payment outside the platform to bypass protections
They only list properties for one night
